# Pradip Kumar Sunuwar

Pradip Kumar Sunuwar () is a Nepalese politician, belonging to the Nepali Congress Party. Sunuwar currently serving as the Minister for Physical Infrastructure Development of Koshi Province. He also serves as a member of the Koshi Provincial Assembly and was elected from Okhaldhunga 1(A) constituency. Sunuwar had served as the Minister for Water Supply, Irrigation and Energy, and later as the Minister for Health  of Koshi Province.
